title: Magnitude-Angle to Complex
text: Convert magnitude and/or a phase angle signal to complex signal, 3 inputs, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Input} sets Type of input; {Angle} sets the phase angle of output, {Magnitude}, {Approximation method} sets the cORDIC, {Number of iterations}, {Scale output by reciprocal of gain factor} scales real and imaginary parts of complex and {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the interval between samples. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: ∠u
ports.summary: Radian phase angle scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Magnitude or radian phase angle scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Input
params.values: Type of input Magnitude (default) | Angle | Magnitude and angle

params.name: Angle
params.values: Phase angle of output 0 (default) | real-valued scalar, vector, or matrix

params.name: Magnitude
params.values: Magnitude of output 0 (default) | real-valued scalar, vector, or matrix

params.name: Number of iterations
params.values: Number of iterations for CORDIC algorithm 11 (default) | positive integer, less than or equal to word length of fixed-point input

params.name: Scale output by reciprocal of gain factor
params.values: Scale real and imaginary parts of complex output on (default) | off
